trickyParts: The role reaper removes a role topic only when two consecutive passes (every 5 min) find it unbacked on the same record revision, and conditionally on that revision, because a claim writes its claimant's topic before the claim itself; after removing, it rereads the claim and puts back the topic of one that landed meanwhile.
The route waits for a detached cleanup only while its budget lasts; a cleanup that fails after the request ended is logged at WARN.
